name: ChemEdit Universal
description: ChemDraw-style structure editor (SMILES, Molfile, SDF, RXN, CDXML, KET, CML, Mol2, XYZ, PDB, SVG/PNG) plus a full lab workspace: ELN with lab-book helpers & TLC photo analysis, compounds, inventory, orders, equipment, protocols, analytics 25 lab calculators, an HTE planner, NMR prediction, synthesis maps and embeddable galleries / inventory tables. Works on mobile.
author: Ruzal Sitdikov
